findings: Auto-choice null plus a configured API checks LLM by default even if an older saved display value was false.
Explicit close survives UI changes and is sent as mllm_user_choice=false at task start.
Pending LLM stage has an adjacent enabled skip action. Early skip keeps local screening running and does not show results prematurely.
Executing review disables the action and states that sent requests cannot be cancelled by skipping.
Failed stage shows real HTTP code and page number instead of the misleading generic execution-complete message.
